## What we adopt
Three-column board (Upcoming / In progress / Completed) of cards with meta row and actions. Chosen over the job-listing candidate because the columns map 1:1 to attempt states.

## What Ad Astra changes
Cards = assigned assessments: due time, duration, language, status, Start/Resume. No images, likes or comments.

Ad Astra branding (plan §1.1) always overrides template colours and logos.
